title: Extended in-distribution results

conventions.fold_combination: within-seed: mean of fold AUCs; retrieval hits pooled over folds
conventions.difference: paired by seed, then mean and sample SD of the per-seed differences
conventions.ood_interval: saved 95% paired query bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 0

caption: Extended in-distribution results for the eight E5-small composition settings and Fedlex. Cells are the mean $\pm$ sample SD ($\mathrm{ddof}{=}1$) across fitting seeds; each seed is scored on its own held-out split and nothing is pooled across seeds. Cohorts: SwiLTra, the primary cohort, 5 seeds (0--4), in all four settings; Fedlex, as in Table~\ref{tab:primary-id} (outer splits by whole law), 5 seeds (0--4); SCOTUS, its five-seed runs, 5 seeds (0--4). Within a setting all methods and metrics come from the same saved run and splits. Metrics are defined in Appendix~\ref{app:extended-id-metrics}. $k$-means LEACE uses the training-silhouette $K$; only Metadata-LEACE uses confounder labels.
